scripts.text: Geck will help you to get to Ash-Vacuum in one piece.
scripts.translation: 。蓋克會確保你平安抵達阿什·真空。

scripts.text: Don't forget, human. The reason why Geck is helping you is to help the Cat Paw Merchant working hard in the other world.
scripts.translation: 別忘了，人類，蓋克幫你是為了讓你去幫助在另一個世界努力工作的貓爪商團。

scripts.text: Now, I will transport you. Go meet our agent in the right corner.
scripts.translation: 現在我就送你過去。去右下角找我們的特工。

scripts.text: But I think you will change your mind.
scripts.translation: 不過我想你會改變主意的。

scripts.text: Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation: 人類，你見到阿什·真空的貓爪商團成員了嗎？

scripts.text: But our Cat Paw Merchant will overcome any obstacle!
scripts.translation: 不過，我們貓爪商團一定能克服所有困難！

scripts.text: Did you meet the Cat Paw Merchant in Ash-Vacuum, human?
scripts.translation: 人類，你見到阿什·真空的貓爪商團成員了嗎？

scripts.text: There is no time to waste, human!
I'll send you back right away!
Hey, human! Didn't you say you will help the Cat Paw Merchant!
scripts.translation: 嘿，人類！你不是說要幫貓爪商團嗎？

scripts.text: A small Cat Paw Agent looks at you and nods its head towards the back.
scripts.translation: 一隻小小的貓爪特工看著你，朝自己的背努了

scripts.text: Looks like it wants you to step up on its back to climb over the wall.
scripts.translation: 努頭。看來它想讓你踩上它的背，翻過牆去。

scripts.text: The small Cat Paw Agent has small black patterns as if it were stamped on it's white fur.
scripts.translation: 這隻小小的貓爪特工雪白的毛上有幾道黑色斑紋，像是蓋上去的印記。

scripts.text: The small body isn't as tall as your ankle and its small but thick paws look like little cushions. The ears that bent backwards when it looked at how big you were stirred up your protective instinct.
scripts.translation: 它的小小身軀還不到你的腳踝高，厚實的小爪子像軟墊一樣。它抬頭望著高大的你，耳朵向後耷拉著，惹人心生憐愛。

scripts.text: You don't seem to have the nerve to step on the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation: 你似乎不忍心踩在貓爪特工身上。

scripts.text: You look at the Cat Paw Agent's small back and climb over the wall as quick as possible so that it wouldn't notice your weight.
scripts.translation: 你看著貓爪特工小小的背，儘可能輕快地翻過牆，不讓它察覺你的重量。

scripts.text: This place as no meaning for us.
scripts.translation: 這個地方對我們沒什麼意義。

scripts.text: I'm the Cat Paw Merchant's rising star, Tat.
scripts.translation: 我是貓爪商團冉冉升起的新星——塔特。

scripts.text: I heard you are offering high-quality fish to pay for our passage.
scripts.translation: 聽說你願意拿上等鮮魚來支付通行費。

scripts.text: I also heard the fish is very fresh and has shiny golden scales.
scripts.translation: 還聽說那些魚非常新鮮，鱗片閃閃發亮。

scripts.text: I usually only allow our Cat Paw Merchant agents to go through but since you are here on Geck's behalf and seeing you are reliable, I'll let you through.
scripts.translation: 通常我只放行貓爪商團的特工。不過你是蓋克派來的，而且看起來值得信任，我就放你過去吧。

scripts.text: Don't forget you are in debt to the Cat Paw Merchant, human!
scripts.translation: 別忘了，人類，你欠貓爪商團一份人情！

scripts.text: Aren't you suppose to be done getting ready before you come here?
scripts.translation: 你不是應該準備好之後再來嗎？
